stylePrompt: Mature learner-facing educational illustration, landscape 3:2, one clear focal meaning, varied painterly or naturalist styles, no photographic or live-action impression, no in-image teaching text, logos or watermarks. Every readable face has natural eyes, nose, mouth and expression; show complete hands. Avoid blank faces, chibi proportions, glossy toy rendering, realistic skin pores, stock-photo staging and readable interfaces.

items.sentenceEn: The botanist will examine the damaged leaf.
items.sentenceZh: 植物学家将检查受损的叶片。
items.scene: One adult botanist uses a hand lens to examine one leaf with small insect holes, comparing its damaged and healthy areas without removing it from the plant.
items.altText: 植物学家用手持放大镜仔细检查叶片上的虫洞。

items.sentenceEn: Her fingertip will touch the water.
items.sentenceZh: 她的指尖将触碰水面。
items.scene: One adult kneels beside a still pond and gently lets one fingertip touch the surface, creating a single set of expanding ripples.
items.altText: 一名成年人用指尖轻触池塘水面，荡开一圈圈波纹。

items.sentenceEn: Please pass the bread.
items.sentenceZh: 请把面包递过来。
items.scene: At a small shared meal, one adult makes a polite open-hand request while another adult smiles and passes one bread basket directly toward them.
items.altText: 共餐时，一人礼貌伸手请求，另一人微笑着递来面包篮。

items.sentenceEn: Six adults attend the pottery workshop.
items.sentenceZh: 六名成年人参加陶艺工作坊。
items.scene: Exactly six adult learners attend a pottery workshop, seated at six wheels and following one standing instructor's demonstration.
items.altText: 六名成年学员在陶轮前参加陶艺工作坊，观看教师示范。

items.sentenceEn: The rain has completely filled the barrel.
items.sentenceZh: 雨水已经把水桶完全装满。
items.scene: A transparent rain barrel stands completely full to the brim beneath a roof downspout, with the water line visibly at the very top and a few drops spilling into an overflow channel.
items.altText: 透明雨水桶的水位到达最顶部，少量水从溢流口流出。

items.sentenceEn: The farm grows a variety of squash.
items.sentenceZh: 农场种植多种南瓜。
items.scene: Exactly eight visibly different squash varieties are arranged separately on a harvest table, differing clearly in shape, color, size and surface texture.
items.altText: 收获桌上分开摆着八种形状、颜色和纹理各异的南瓜。

items.sentenceEn: He can sleep peacefully in the hammock.
items.sentenceZh: 他可以在吊床里安稳地睡觉。
items.scene: One adult sleeps peacefully in a securely tied hammock under shade, eyes closed, body relaxed, with shoes and a book placed neatly below.
items.altText: 一名成年人在树荫下稳固的吊床中闭眼熟睡。

items.sentenceEn: Everyone is involved in planting the garden.
items.sentenceZh: 每个人都参与了花园种植。
items.scene: Exactly four adults are actively involved in one community garden project: one digs, one plants, one waters and one spreads mulch, with no passive observer.
items.altText: 四名成年人分别挖土、栽苗、浇水和铺覆盖物，全部参与种植。

items.sentenceEn: The investigation follows the muddy footprints.
items.sentenceZh: 调查沿着泥脚印展开。
items.scene: Two adult investigators study a nonviolent greenhouse mystery: muddy boot prints lead from a loose door latch to a toppled empty pot. One photographs the prints while the other examines the latch.
items.altText: 两名调查人员沿温室里的泥脚印检查松动门闩和倒下的空花盆。

items.meaningZh: 核子的；原子能的；核的；中心的
items.sentenceEn: The nuclear plant generates electricity.
items.sentenceZh: 核电站产生电力。
items.scene: A distant, orderly nuclear power station shows one domed reactor containment building and two cooling towers releasing only white water vapor, with power lines carrying electricity away through a green landscape.
items.altText: 整洁的核电站包含圆顶安全壳和两座冒出白色水汽的冷却塔。

items.sentenceEn: The researcher records the heron's behavior.
items.sentenceZh: 研究员记录苍鹭的行为。
items.scene: One adult field researcher observes one heron through binoculars from a respectful distance and records its behavior with simple marks in a notebook.
items.altText: 一名野外研究员用望远镜观察苍鹭，并在笔记本上记录。

items.sentenceEn: They press the apples to make juice.
items.sentenceZh: 他们压榨苹果制作果汁。
items.scene: Exactly two adults turn the handle of a traditional fruit press, visibly compressing crushed apples while fresh juice streams into one clean jug below.
items.altText: 两名成年人转动传统压榨机，把碎苹果压出果汁。

items.sentenceEn: The two carts conflict over the narrow bridge.
items.sentenceZh: 两辆小车在窄桥通行上发生冲突。
items.scene: Two small delivery carts meet nose to nose at the center of a one-lane bridge and cannot pass. Their two adult drivers stop safely and gesture toward the limited space, showing a practical conflict without anger or violence.
items.altText: 两辆送货小车在单车道桥中央相遇，司机因无法同时通过而协商。

items.sentenceEn: The rowers show strong team spirit.
items.sentenceZh: 赛艇队员展现出强烈的团队精神。
items.scene: Exactly four adult rowers gather beside their boat before practice and stack one hand each in the center, smiling with shared determination and team spirit.
items.altText: 四名赛艇队员在船边把手叠在一起，展现团结昂扬的精神。

items.sentenceEn: The mechanic will replace the worn tire.
items.sentenceZh: 技师将更换磨损的轮胎。
items.scene: One adult bicycle mechanic removes one visibly worn cracked tire and fits one new treaded tire onto the same wheel, with old and new clearly contrasted.
items.altText: 自行车技师从车轮上取下磨损旧胎并装上带新纹路的轮胎。

items.sentenceEn: The British ferry approaches the white cliffs.
items.sentenceZh: 英国渡轮驶近白色悬崖。
items.scene: One unbranded passenger ferry with a small British maritime ensign approaches distinctive white chalk cliffs across calm water. A subtle outline map of Great Britain appears on a travel board without labels.
items.altText: 一艘悬挂小型英国海事旗的渡轮驶向白色粉笔悬崖。

items.sentenceEn: Her teammate will encourage her to continue.
items.sentenceZh: 队友会鼓励她继续前进。
items.scene: At a safe indoor climbing wall, one harnessed adult pauses on an easy route while exactly one adult teammate below smiles, raises an encouraging hand and manages the belay rope correctly.
items.altText: 室内攀岩者在简单路线中停顿，负责保护的队友微笑举手鼓励。

items.sentenceEn: They have an argument about the route.
items.sentenceZh: 他们为路线发生争论。
items.scene: Exactly two adult hikers have a verbal argument over an open map: each calmly but firmly points to a different route, with frustrated expressions but no threatening posture or physical contact.
items.altText: 两名徒步者各指地图上的不同路线，神情不满地进行口头争论。

items.sentenceEn: Their camp stands beside the forest.
items.sentenceZh: 他们的营地设在森林旁。
items.scene: An organized camp beside a forest edge includes exactly two secured tents, a covered cooking table and exactly three adults preparing an evening meal with a contained stove.
items.altText: 森林边的营地有两顶帐篷，三名成年人用安全炉具准备晚餐。

items.sentenceEn: The doctor explains the human brain.
items.sentenceZh: 医生讲解人类大脑。
items.scene: One adult doctor holds a large accurate anatomical model of the human brain while exactly two adult learners examine its two hemispheres and folded surface. No surgery or patient.
items.altText: 医生手持准确的人脑模型，向两名成年学习者展示脑半球和沟回。
